title: Leonids Meteor Shower Peak (2026)
description: Annual Leonids meteor shower peak produced by debris from comet Tempel-Tuttle. Best viewed under dark skies after midnight.

title: Geminids Meteor Shower Peak (2026)
description: Major annual Geminids meteor shower peak, originating from asteroid 3200 Phaethon with bright, multi-colored meteors.

title: Ursids Meteor Shower Peak (2026)
description: Minor late-year meteor shower radiating from Ursa Minor, associated with comet 8P/Tuttle.

title: Quadrantids Meteor Shower Peak (2027)
description: Strong northern hemisphere meteor shower with a sharp peak lasting just a few hours.

title: Lyrids Meteor Shower Peak (2027)
description: Medium strength shower radiating from constellation Lyra, produced by comet C/1861 G1 Thatcher.

title: Eta Aquariids Meteor Shower Peak (2027)
description: Fast meteors associated with Halley's Comet, best viewed in the pre-dawn hours.

title: Total Lunar Eclipse
description: Total lunar eclipse with totality duration of ~58 minutes; Moon passes completely into Earth's umbral shadow.

title: Total Solar Eclipse
description: Total solar eclipse path crossing Greenland, western Iceland, and northern Spain.

title: Partial Lunar Eclipse
description: Partial lunar eclipse visible primarily across the Americas and Pacific.

title: Annular Solar Eclipse
description: Annular solar eclipse (ring of fire) path passing through the South Pacific, South America, and Atlantic.
